Tasks

Living end-user product checklist for MuxCore (installer, fixture-first media path, self-hosted CI).

Where What
This wiki page Short pointer + constraints
Workspace Canonical checklist: TASKS.md (sibling of _mvp/ in the local MuxCore multi-repo workspace)
Roadmap wiki page Also redirects here — no separate checkbox roadmap

Previous per-module ROADMAP.md files and older wiki Roadmap checklists are retired. Do not add new “see ROADMAP” links; point at TASKS.md or this page.

Constraints (same as workspace)

  • Laptop + GitHub free account only
  • Self-hosted CI runners (runs-on: self-hosted); local registry for images
  • Fixture / mock / httptest acquisition for product gates — no live pirate indexers or swarms as requirements
  • No paid Actions / Packages / cloud IdP / debrid as hard dependencies

Doc entry points

  • Getting Started — installer / release binaries + fixture-first acquisition
  • Deployment — single laptop, self-hosted CI, local registry
  • Configuration Reference — loom config and env overrides
  • Port Map — canonical gRPC/HTTP ports for installer / _mvp (collision remaps)
